title: RC1 and Dev-J AAPS will not update profiles from NS unless new DB record is created or cloned - updating existing record in latest DB will not work
symptom: When using remote profiles on NS, editing an existing profile record does not push changes to AAPS or AAPSClient in RC1 and Dev-J builds. Changes only flow if a new DB record is created or cloned. In previous master, updating an existing record worked.
cause: The problem is on NS side. NS is not timestamping changes in profile, so AAPS does not detect updates to existing records.
fix: Create a new DB record or clone the existing one to force a new timestamp, then save it. Alternatively, wait for the next update or pause and unpause NSClientV3 to pull the latest profile data.
evidence_quote: The problem is on NS side. NS is not timestamping changes in profile. That's the reason why you need to create new record.
